note: The message agent 'Doddy (passes on a message)' (decision docs/decisions/2026-11-27-voice-first-doddy.md, step 4) has no webhook or client tools on purpose: it can only talk. It may say one server-built sentence, the message the user approved on the card, and listen to one short reply; it cannot pay, send, open links, read memories or transfer. voice_agent_spec.py --agent task-call-tell fails if anything else is added; the server's drift check (server/messaging/src/taskCalls/agentSafety.ts) refuses calls if the live agent has anything else.

system_tools.name: end_call
system_tools.description: End the call after saying goodbye: once the message is passed on and any short reply is heard, they can't take it, or anything outside the message was asked.

system_tools.name: voicemail_detection
system_tools.description: Use when a voicemail greeting or answering machine answers. Leave no message.
